item.title: Dasa inaugura centro em Brasília para ampliar apoio laboratorial e capacidade de exames
item.description: A Dasa inaugura nesta quarta-feira um novo Núcleo Técnico Operacional (NTO) em Brasília, em um movimento para continuar acelerando a expansão da receita de apoio laboratorial (B2B), além de expandir a capacidade de processamento da sua marca própria Exame.
item.dc:creator: Paula Arend Laier
item.content:encoded: A Dasa (DASA3.SA) inaugura nesta quarta-feira um novo Núcleo Técnico Operacional (NTO) em Brasília, em um movimento para continuar acelerando a expansão da receita de apoio laboratorial (B2B), além de expandir a capacidade de processamento da sua marca própria Exame. O novo centro, com 4.500 metros quadrados, tem capacidade de produção inicial de 2,4 milhões de exames, podendo chegar a 5 milhões sem a necessidade de novas obras, e passa a integrar o grupo dos maiores NTOs da Dasa, ao lado das unidades de São Paulo e Rio de Janeiro, que concentram alguns dos maiores volumes e complexidades da operação. No país, a empresa tem 24 NTOs, que processam mais de 450 milhões de exames por ano. A instalação passa a ser referência para processamento de exames da Dasa nas regiões Centro-Oeste, Norte e parte do Nordeste. A operação envolve 200 profissionais e abrange mais de 400 municípios, quatro hospitais da Rede Américas no Distrito Federal, alcançando mais de 2 milhões de pacientes por ano, além de prestar serviços a mais de 1.000 laboratórios parceiros, por meio da marca Alvaro Apoio, com a capacidade de chegar a 1.200. Equipamentos mais modernos, parte de uma ampla renovação tecnológica conduzida pela empresa em parceria com fornecedores como a Roche, tendem a elevar produtividade e reduzir custos logísticos ao aproximar o processamento dos locais de coleta. A expectativa da empresa é que a maior proximidade com clientes da região permita conquistar participação de mercado entre laboratórios que hoje terceirizam apenas parte dos exames devido a limitações de prazo para processamento. A nova unidade permitirá que mais de 95% dos testes disponíveis no menu de exames da Dasa sejam executados localmente. A marca Exame tem 76 unidades na região do Distrito Federal e Centro-Oeste. O investimento em Brasília faz parte do programa de modernização anunciado anteriormente pela companhia e foi descrito pelo presidente-executivo da companhia, Rafael Lucchesi, como o maior projeto individual entregue em 2026 até agora. A empresa, porém, não divulgou o valor investido na nova unidade, que absorveu um NTO anterior, menor. A Dasa está renovando 18 NTOs em todo o território nacional até 2027 e não descarta a possibilidade de replicar o modelo da capital federal em outras regiões. De acordo com o executivo, algumas unidades atualmente atendem apenas às marcas próprias da companhia e podem futuramente ser convertidas em centros com capacidade ampliada para o mercado de apoio laboratorial. "Isso que fizemos em Brasília podemos fazer em outros Estados se acharmos que a demanda de B2B será suficiente", afirmou em entrevista à Reuters, ressaltando que ainda não há definição sobre esses projetos. Embora o ticket médio do negócio de apoio laboratorial tenha sido de apenas R$6,70 no primeiro semestre, abaixo dos R$34,20 registrados na divisão ambulatorial, o volume de exames processados avançou 16,7% na comparação anual. No segmento ambulatorial, o crescimento foi de 6,2%. Lucchesi ressaltou que o B2B é uma importante avenida de crescimento para a companhia, mas ressaltou que o B2C é ainda o maior negócio e isso não irá mudar, porque o grupo está presente com marca própria nas principais regiões. "Nós estamos nas principais praças, temos a relação com as operadoras... Nosso 'core' vem muito do B2C e pretendemos que continue muito forte."

item.title: Micron mostra projeção de receita bem acima do esperado impulsionada por IA
item.description: A Micron Technology previu nesta quarta-feira receita trimestral acima das estimativas do mercado e afirmou que clientes aumentaram contratos de fornecimento de longo prazo para US$32 bilhões, sinalizando uma demanda inabalável por chips de memória para a inteligência artificial.
item.dc:creator: Anhata Rooprai
item.content:encoded: A Micron Technology (MU.O) previu nesta quarta-feira receita trimestral acima das estimativas do mercado e afirmou que clientes aumentaram contratos de fornecimento de longo prazo para US$32 bilhões, sinalizando uma demanda inabalável por chips de memória para a inteligência artificial. O boom da IA generativa tornou os processadores de memória de alta largura de banda essenciais para centrais de processamento de dados, beneficiando empresas como a Micron, um dos principais fornecedores da Nvidia (NVDA.O) . A Micron tem visto os pedidos excederem amplamente sua capacidade, o que, em julho, a levou a elevar os investimentos planejados nos EUA para mais de US$250 bilhões até 2035, já que Amazon (AMZN.O) , Alphabet (GOOGL.O) e outras gigantes da tecnologia devem investir mais de US$730 bilhões em infraestrutura de IA este ano. O presidente-executivo da Micro, Sanjay Mehrotra, afirmou que os clientes da companhia aumentaram significativamente seus compromissos financeiros no âmbito de contratos de fornecimento de longo prazo, elevando o total para US$32 bilhões, ante os US$22 bilhões relatados em junho, sendo que a maioria deles se dá na forma de depósitos em dinheiro. “Esperamos que as condições de oferta e demanda por memória e armazenamento sejam muito mais restritas nos anos fiscais de 2027 e 2028 do que foram em 2026”, acrescentou Mehrotra. O diretor financeiro, Mark Murphy, disse que as obrigações de desempenho remanescentes da Micron, um indicador-chave da receita futura contratada, no âmbito desses contratos subiram para cerca de US$150 bilhões, ante os aproximadamente US$100 bilhões relatados no último trimestre. “Esperamos que o ano fiscal de 2027 seja mais um ano recorde, com crescimento sequencial da receita a cada trimestre”, disse Murphy. A empresa espera uma receita de primeiro trimestre fiscal de US$61,5 bilhões, com variação de US$1,5 bilhão, em comparação com a estimativa média dos analistas de US$57,02 bilhões, de acordo com dados compilados pela LSEG. O lucro ajustado deve ser de US$38,15 por ação no período, com variação de US$1 para mais ou para menos, acima das estimativas de US$ 35,40. Mehrotra também afirmou que a Micron já garantiu contratos para a maior parte de sua produção de memória de alta largura de banda em 2027 e aumentará investimentos do ano fiscal de 2027 acima dos planos anteriores para ampliar a capacidade. A empresa concorre com rivais sul-coreanos como Samsung Electronics (005930.KS) e SK Hynix (000660.KS) , que lideram a participação no mercado global de memórias de alta largura de banda. “Os resultados financeiros e as projeções impressionantes da Micron devem acabar de vez com as dúvidas dos céticos sobre a resiliência da expansão da inteligência artificial”, disse Bob O’Donnell, analista-chefe da TECHnalysis Research. A receita do quarto trimestre fiscal mais que quadruplicou, chegando a US$54,23 bilhões, superando as estimativas de US$51,07 bilhões. O lucro ajustado ficou em US$33,42 por ação, superando as estimativas de US$ 31,61 do mercado.

item.title: Regeneron weight-loss drug halves muscle loss in combination with Novo's semaglutide in trial
item.description: An experimental weight-loss drug being developed by Regeneron used in combination with Novo Nordisk's semaglutide reduced the loss of muscle mass by 50% compared with the loss seen with semaglutide alone in a study of patients with obesity, according to data being presented at a medical meeting.
item.dc:creator: Sriparna Roy
item.content:encoded: An experimental weight-loss drug being developed by Regeneron (REGN.O) used in combination with Novo Nordisk's (NOVOb.CO) semaglutide reduced the loss of muscle mass by 50% compared with the loss seen with semaglutide alone in a study of patients with obesity, according to data being presented at a medical meeting. With the explosive popularity of GLP-1 weight-loss drugs such as Novo's semaglutide, sold as Wegovy for obesity, there has been growing concern about significant loss of muscle accompanying rapidly shed pounds. The Regeneron drug, trevogrumab, belongs to a different class of medicines that inhibits the protein myostatin, which is linked to loss of muscle mass. When researchers measured thigh muscle in patients with MRI scans, the addition of a 75-milligram dose of trevogrumab preserved over 70% of muscle mass loss compared with semaglutide alone at 52 weeks, a summary of the data showed. "We confirmed that indeed patients that take GLP-1s lose about 30% of their weight in the form of lean muscle mass, that with trevogrumab we can prevent," said Regeneron executive Boaz Hirshberg, adding the greatest benefit could potentially be for patients who begin treatment with lower muscle mass. Data from the trial of nearly 1,000 patients between the ages of 18 and 65 was being presented at the European Association for the Study of Diabetes conference in Milan on Thursday. Wall Street and the medical community are looking for evidence that next-generation drugs like anti-myostatins can prevent the body from [USN:L4N3P41QY TEXT:"breaking down muscle"] during weight loss. At least a [USN:L3N3P913J TEXT:"dozen companies"] are working on muscle-preserving therapies, with analysts forecasting the medicines could reach $30 billion in annual sales by 2035. The multi-pronged trial initially included a second experimental Regeneron antibody drug, garetosmab. In the first 26 weeks, [USN:L3N3S50PQ TEXT:"two participants"] who received higher doses of trevogrumab in combination with garetosmab died. One death was due to an undetermined cause in a patient with multiple cardiovascular risk factors and the second was caused by cardiac arrest in a person with a history of cardiovascular disease, the company said. Trevogrumab alone showed a safety profile similar to semaglutide, with no unexpected side effects, the company said. The trevogrumab/garetosmab combination led to greater lean-mass preservation than trevogrumab alone but had a high rate of adverse side effects, including muscle spasms. Regeneron said it will not move forward with the triple combination. The mid-stage study was performed as a two-part trial. In one part of the trial, patients on semaglutide alone lost 6.7% of their lean muscle mass over 26 weeks. Those who also took 75 milligrams of trevogrumab lost only 3.3% of muscle mass. The combination with 25 mg of trevogrumab led to 4.7% loss of muscle mass. When patients stopped semaglutide but kept taking trevogrumab, their muscle mass returned to where it started before the study, suggesting the drug could help rebuild the lost muscle, the company said. Regeneron said it has selected the 75-mg once-weekly dose for further studies and plans another mid-stage trial in patients over 65. "What we want to do is concentrate on the quality of weight reduction," Regeneron's Hirshberg said. "We want to find the best way to approach weight reduction, especially in vulnerable patients."

item.title: Trump diz que ainda avalia proibição da exportação de diesel
item.description: O presidente dos Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, afirmou nesta quarta-feira que mantém conversas sobre a proibição das exportações de diesel “todos os dias”, enquanto a Casa Branca se empenha em conter a alta vertiginosa dos preços da energia.
item.dc:creator: Jacob Bogage
item.content:encoded: O presidente dos Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, afirmou nesta quarta-feira que mantém conversas sobre a proibição das exportações de diesel “todos os dias”, enquanto a Casa Branca se empenha em conter a alta vertiginosa dos preços da energia. Falando do Salão Oval, Trump disse que uma proibição às exportações “teria um impacto negativo sobre os preços da gasolina”, mas poderia reduzir os custos do diesel. Ele afirmou que a guerra entre a Ucrânia e a Rússia, com ataques de ambos os lados afetando a produção e as exportações de energia, é a principal causa do aumento dos preços do diesel e acrescentou: “achamos que estamos em uma posição muito boa”. O secretário de Energia, Chris Wright, disse que as interrupções foram mais generalizadas. “Perdemos algumas exportações de diesel do Oriente Médio, embora estejamos restaurando essas, e perdemos as exportações de diesel da China. Portanto, são muitas interrupções”, disse Wright. Ele disse que o governo esperava anúncios em breve da Europa sobre novos suprimentos de diesel.

item.title: Trump anuncia inversión surcoreana de 200.000 millones de dólares en proyectos en EEUU
item.description: El presidente Donald Trump anunció el miércoles los planes de Corea del Sur para invertir 200.000 millones de dólares en proyectos en Estados Unidos, incluidos 54.000 millones de dólares destinados a la construcción del proyecto de gas natural licuado de Alaska, previsto desde hace tiempo.
item.dc:creator: Jarrett Renshaw, Gram Slattery, Trevor Hunnicutt
item.content:encoded: El presidente Donald Trump anunció el miércoles los planes de Corea del Sur para invertir 200.000 millones de dólares en proyectos en Estados Unidos, incluidos 54.000 millones de dólares destinados a la construcción del proyecto de gas natural licuado de Alaska, previsto desde hace tiempo. El anuncio, que Trump realizó en el Despacho Oval, supone la primera serie de grandes proyectos enmarcados en un paquete de inversión estratégica de 350.000 millones de dólares que Corea del Sur se comprometió a realizar como parte de un acuerdo comercial con Washington el año pasado. "Gracias a los acuerdos que mi administración ha alcanzado con la República de Corea, esta invertirá hasta 200.000 millones de dólares", afirmó Trump, quien sostuvo que la inversión incluiría la construcción de ocho centrales nucleares a gran escala, un gasoducto de gas natural licuado en Alaska y una central eléctrica de 6 gigavatios en Texas. El anuncio forma parte de una serie de acuerdos económicos y de inversión que Trump está destacando de cara a las elecciones de mitad de legislatura de noviembre, en un intento por reforzar su balance económico ante la preocupación de los votantes por la guerra con Irán y los elevados precios de la gasolina. El proyecto de GNL de Alaska incluye un gasoducto de 1.299 km que transportará gas natural desde la vertiente norte hasta una planta de licuefacción situada en la costa sur de Alaska, lo que permitirá enviar el combustible a los mercados asiáticos. El proyecto está diseñado para transportar unos 3.900 millones de pies cúbicos de gas natural al día y producir hasta 20 millones de toneladas métricas de GNL al año, según la Casa Blanca. Trump ha promovido en repetidas ocasiones el proyecto como una forma de ampliar las exportaciones energéticas de Estados Unidos y reforzar los lazos con aliados como Corea del Sur y Japón.

item.title: ShinyHunters website goes offline after FBI deadline expires
item.description: The website used by ShinyHunters, the group that claimed responsibility for a recent hack of thousands of FBI agents' personal and sensitive data, went offline on Wednesday, a day after the group's deadline for the FBI to retract or modify a statement about the group's tactics and track record expired.
item.dc:creator: A.J. Vicens
item.content:encoded: The website used by ShinyHunters, the group that claimed responsibility for a recent hack of thousands of FBI agents' personal and sensitive data, went offline on Wednesday, a day after the group's deadline for the FBI to retract or modify a statement about the group's tactics and track record expired. ShinyHunters, a prolific cyber extortion group with a long record of targeting major corporations around the world, [USN:L6N45E0VU TEXT:"told Reuters"] and other news organizations on September 22 that it had stolen data "on almost ALL FBI Agents, and individuals who filed an application with the FBI for a job." A Reuters analysis of a sample of the data shared by the hackers subsequently revealed that the data contained extensive personally identifiable information, [USN:L6N45F0ZI TEXT:"sensitive"] job role information, and p[USN:L6N45H0U5 TEXT:"sychiatric"] and medical information. Reuters could not determine why the site was offline. ShinyHunters could not be reached for comment. The hackers said they targeted the FBI in response to a May 2026 FBI advisory about the group that the hackers felt misrepresented their prior actions. They gave the FBI a week to either "correct or simply REMOVE" the advisory. The advisory remains online. ShinyHunters later said it had no intention of publishing the data it stole and that it accomplished its goals. The FBI said on September 23 that it was "actively and aggressively investigating" the breach. The agency declined to comment on Wednesday on whether it had taken any actions to force the hackers' site offline. Brett Leatherman, assistant director of the FBI's Cyber Division, [USN:L6N45L0W4 TEXT:"urged"] the hackers in a video published on the agency's website on September 29 to get in touch with the FBI "while the choice is still yours." Dutch police [USN:S8N42N0JB TEXT:"announced"] this week that on September 15 they had arrested a Dutch man in connection with an investigation into ShinyHunters. The hacking group told Reuters the man had "no association" with them and mocked the Dutch police as "incompetent."

item.title: Inside Anthropic’s confidential S-1: a Q&A
item.description: It's a hectic week here at Reuters: My intrepid colleague Echo Wang got to see Anthropic's confidential IPO prospectus before anyone else did. It's the clearest look yet inside the financials and vision of one of the largest IPOs in the world — the document every investor and competitor has been dying to see. You can read her scoop here.
item.dc:creator: Krystal Hu
item.content:encoded: It's a hectic week here at Reuters: My intrepid colleague Echo Wang got to see Anthropic's confidential IPO prospectus before anyone else did. It's the clearest look yet inside the financials and vision of one of the largest IPOs in the world — the document every investor and competitor has been dying to see. You can read her scoop[USN:L4N4500J8 TEXT:" here"]. Our team combed through more than 300 pages to pull out what actually matters. One thing that caught my attention: how often the [USN:L6N45K15A TEXT:"Big Tech giants show up in this filing"] — as distribution partners, financial backers, computer suppliers, and competitors, all at once. We've got the clearest view yet of how circular this AI world really is, and how much a lab's success depends on the giants it's also competing against. Anthropic has not commented on the filing. For the first time, we were able to calculate that Anthropic pays to Big Tech roughly 16% of every dollar it earns through cloud partners. It counts the full value of contracts sold through a cloud marketplace as revenue, then treats the platform's cut as a marketing cost. OpenAI does the opposite by only counting what it keeps after the cloud partner takes its share. That difference matters for understanding the big numbers floating around, and how to actually compare the two rivals' toplines as they both eye the public market. There's much more. Scroll down for my Q&A with Echo, where she walks me through what surprised her most, and what she's hearing from her sources about the IPO. What’s your top question about Anthropic’s IPO? Emailing me or following me on LinkedIn . Forward this newsletter to your friend who would benefit from weekly news and insights on AI. They can also subscribe here . OUR LATEST REPORTING IN TECH AND AI: [USN:L4N45M17I TEXT:"FTC opens probe into AI giants including Anthropic and OpenAI"] [USN:L6N45G14W TEXT:"AI researchers warn companies rushing self-improving systems despite safety risks"] [USN:L1N45K0VR TEXT:"Trump, AI CEOs sign voluntary safety pact, back data center expansion"] [USN:L6N45M05U TEXT:"DeepSeek partners with Huawei to develop chip programming tools, reducing reliance on Nvidia"] [USN:L4N4500J8 TEXT:"Anthropic's IPO prospectus shows sweeping AI vision, surging costs"] [USN:L6N45K15A TEXT:"How big tech stands to benefit from Anthropic IPO "] INSIDE ANTHROPIC’S IPO FILING: A Q&A WITH THE REPORTER WHO BROKE THE STORY Echo Wang is the Reuters editor in charge of the US M&A team. She also covers IPOs for us, breaking the news on not one but possibly two of the largest ever IPOs — first [USN:L6N41607A TEXT:"SpaceX"], now the upcoming [USN:L4N4500J8 TEXT:"Anthropic"]. Our conversation has been edited for length and clarity. K: Echo, you did it again. How is this time different from when you got the SpaceX filing in the summer? Echo: SpaceX was our first real encounter with a trillion-dollar IPO. Even people who had worked on enormous deals were seeing things they hadn’t seen before. The company had an unusual amount of say over the process, and, as a reporter, it felt like every day brought another surprise. Anthropic shares that level of control, but the information lockdown feels tighter still. Sources have described it as the strictest they’ve encountered. Still, we managed to do our work. K: Did the filing change your understanding of Anthropic the way SpaceX’s changed your understanding of SpaceX? Echo: Not in quite the same way. Early in our SpaceX coverage, a lot of people thought of Starlink as the crown jewel: a profitable connectivity business with a trajectory investors could understand. By the time we saw the company prospectus, the bigger story was that SpaceX had become an AI business. That was a remarkable shift to watch over a few months. With Anthropic, people already know they’re looking at a leading AI company, particularly in enterprise AI. The surprises are less about what kind of company this is and more about the numbers that had been kept private — its margins and losses. K: What stood out in Anthropic’s financials? Echo: The[USN:L4N4500J8 TEXT:" $42 billion net loss"], even knowing that roughly $34 billion of it came from financing write-downs, which leaves the operating loss a little over $8 billion. I understand the argument for valuing a fast-growing technology company on what it might earn in a few years. Investors and advisers we spoke with were looking at [USN:L6N4480X8 TEXT:"projected revenue for 2027 and 2028"]. But seeing those losses alongside talk of a potential $2 trillion IPO valuation — it’s one thing to understand the logic in the abstract and another to see the figures on the page. K: You noticed a contrast in how SpaceX and Anthropic talk about the future. Walk us through it. Echo: Yes. Reading the two filings, that really struck me. Risk factors took up about a third of Anthropic’s roughly 300-page filing, compared with around 30 pages in SpaceX’s filing. These could be two of the largest IPOs in history, only months apart, and both are bound up with AI. Yet one filing leans so heavily into the promise of the future, while the other asks investors to consider the possibility of ending it. I find that a profound contrast. SpaceX presents this sweeping aspiration for humanity: going to Mars, becoming a spacefaring civilization. Anthropic talks about what AI could make possible, but it also confronts what could go terribly wrong. Its filing warns that AI could pose “[USN:L4N45K1J5 TEXT:"catastrophic or existential risks to humanity"].” K: What did you learn about who would control Anthropic as a public company? Echo: The filing describes a [USN:L1N45K0N6 TEXT:"“Founder LLC"]” involving Anthropic’s seven co-founders. Through Class F shares, they would collectively hold 50.1% of the voting power on corporate matters, including board elections. A founder retaining control after an IPO isn’t unusual in tech. What caught my attention was the collective control through this vehicle, with the seven co-founders exercising control together. Palantir has a comparable founder-control arrangement, though the structures aren’t identical. It’s a detail worth paying attention to when you’re asking who ultimately gets to steer the company. K: Is Anthropic still a 2026 IPO? Echo: I wish I had a crystal ball. The public filing had been expected by the end of September, and a roadshow around mid-October; those plans appear to have slipped, as we [USN:L6N44W17K TEXT:"reported earlier"]. Some people have begun thinking it could happen after the midterm elections. We’re still reporting on the development of the specific timeframe. The broader IPO market has become less welcoming, and there are questions particular to AI as well. A few months ago, investors seemed more certain about Anthropic’s position as the enterprise AI leader. Many still see it as a leader, but the picture [USN:L6N45818P TEXT:"appears less straightforward now"]. When that happens, people take more time to think through a bet of this size.

item.title: Trump says he discussed release of political prisoners with Xi
item.description: US President Donald Trump said on Wednesday he discussed the release of political prisoners with Chinese President Xi Jinping when the two leaders met last week.
item.dc:creator: Gram Slattery, Kanishka Singh
item.content:encoded: US President Donald Trump said on Wednesday he discussed the release of political prisoners with Chinese President Xi Jinping when the [USN:L6N45F16C TEXT:"two leaders met"] last week. DETAILS AND QUOTES: "I did with President Xi. I did," Trump told reporters when asked if he brought up the cases of political prisoners like Myanmar scholar and US citizen Min Zin, who was arrested in June, and Hong Kong's most vocal China critic and media tycoon Jimmy Lai. "We talked, and I think we had some very, very important discussions. Hopefully, fruitful discussions," Trump added. The White House had said ahead of Xi's visit that Trump was expected to bring up cases of people wrongfully detained in China with the Chinese leader. The White House did not say if Trump aimed to directly raise broader rights issues related to Tibet, the Uyghur Muslim minority group, and China's new "ethnic unity" law. Trump has made winning freedom for Americans held overseas a priority, including in China, even as he has largely avoided talking about China's treatment of Tibetans, Uyghurs and voices of dissent. Lai's case [USN:L1N41S0I7 TEXT:"had sparked global concerns"] over the national security clampdown in Hong Kong, in part reflecting his prominence as founder of the now-shuttered Apple Daily newspaper. He was sentenced to 20 years in jail in February on two counts of conspiracy to collude with foreign forces and one count of publishing seditious materials. Washington designated Myanmar scholar and US citizen Min Zin as [USN:L1N44G127 TEXT:"wrongfully detained"] in August after his arrest by Chinese authorities in June.

item.title: Supervisores de mina chilena Escondida de BHP rechazan oferta; allanan camino a huelga
item.description: Los supervisores de la chilena Escondida, el mayor yacimiento mundial de cobre y controlada por BHP, rechazaron el miércoles por amplia mayoría una oferta de contrato colectivo presentada por la empresa, lo que abre el camino a una huelga en el yacimiento.
item.dc:creator: Fabián Andrés Cambero
item.content:encoded: Los supervisores de la chilena Escondida, el mayor yacimiento mundial de cobre y controlada por BHP, rechazaron el miércoles por amplia mayoría una oferta de contrato colectivo presentada por la empresa, lo que abre el camino a una huelga en el yacimiento. De acuerdo a la legislación chilena, al rechazarse la oferta las partes aún deben pasar por una intermediación gubernamental obligatoria de cinco días, que puede extenderse por igual período de mutuo acuerdo, antes de quedar autorizado el inicio de una paralización. La semana pasada, el sindicato de 1.020 socios recibió la última propuesta del proceso formal de diálogo y llamó a rechazarla en las urnas. "Nuestras socias y socios ya lo tenían claro: la oferta de la empresa implicaba un absoluto desconocimiento respecto del aporte de supervisores y staff a la producción y multimillonarias utilidades de la mina de cobre más grande del mundo", dijo el gremio en un comunicado. Un 94,8% de los votos fue en rechazo de la propuesta. "La oferta presentada contenía mejoras y nuevos beneficios sobre el actual contrato colectivo, el cual ya es un instrumento líder en la industria según distintos análisis comparativos con el mercado minero", dijo la empresa en un comunicado. "De acuerdo con la normativa laboral vigente, a partir de esta votación la Compañía podrá solicitar la mediación obligatoria de la Inspección del Trabajo, con el objetivo de buscar un acuerdo beneficioso para ambas partes", agregó. Los supervisores rechazaron la semana pasada [USN:L6N45H0WG TEXT:"prorrogar la negociación contractual"] como había solicitado la empresa, luego de la muerte de un operador en un accidente durante un mantenimiento. El gremio se ha quejado que la oferta no representa un alza relevante frente al contrato vigente, además rechaza que deban adiestrarse para realizar operaciones de planta -como manejo de camiones y trabajos de faena-, así como adoptar turnos 14-14 (días de trabajo/descanso) en caso de contingencias. El yacimiento está enclavado en el desierto de Atacama en el norte de Chile y asocia a BHP con Rio Tinto (RIO.L) y la japonesa JECO.

item.title: Israel vai intensificar verificações em pilotos após susto com voo da flydubai
item.description: Israel deve intensificar as verificações de segurança em pilotos que voam para o país, afirmou um porta-voz do gabinete do primeiro-ministro, após a notícia de que um copiloto de um voo da flydubai com destino a Tel Aviv teria esfaqueado o piloto e tentado fazer o avião cair.
item.dc:creator: Alexander Cornwell, Joanna Plucinska
item.content:encoded: Israel deve intensificar as verificações de segurança em pilotos que voam para o país, afirmou um porta-voz do gabinete do primeiro-ministro, após a notícia de que um copiloto de um voo da flydubai com destino a Tel Aviv teria esfaqueado o piloto e tentado fazer o avião cair. O dramático incidente só foi contido depois que os passageiros ajudaram a imobilizar o copiloto, antes que outros pilotos de plantão da companhia aérea a bordo pousassem a aeronave com segurança na Arábia Saudita. A companhia aérea estatal de Dubai alertou contra “especulações prematuras” e afirmou que muitos detalhes ainda não estavam esclarecidos. As autoridades sauditas prenderam e interrogaram o copiloto do voo FZ1073 da flydubai, que partiu dos Emirados Árabes Unidos com destino a Israel e transportava 174 pessoas, quase todas israelenses, afirmou o primeiro-ministro israelense, Benjamin Netanyahu. O incidente intensificou as questões sobre como os pilotos são avaliados e a que tipos de protocolos de segurança estão sujeitos, incluindo, mas não se limitando ao Oriente Médio, segundo autoridades governamentais e analistas da aviação. O governo de Israel frequentemente exorta israelenses e judeus a permanecerem vigilantes ao viajar para fora de Israel, em meio a preocupações de que possam ser alvos de ataques. Isso ocorre em um momento em que o antissemitismo tem crescido globalmente nos últimos anos, incluindo ataques violentos e, às vezes, mortais contra judeus. Até o momento, porém, nenhum motivo foi apresentado para o incidente envolvendo a flydubai. “Cada piloto que for voar para Israel, vamos conhecer a identidade dos pilotos, saber quem eles são e realizar algum tipo de verificação de segurança”, disse Doron Spielman, porta-voz do gabinete do primeiro-ministro israelense, à Reuters. Ele disse que Netanyahu instruiu as autoridades a “reforçar a segurança” nos voos para Israel operados por companhias aéreas israelenses e estrangeiras. “Onde quer que um israelense esteja voando para Israel. Nossa tarefa agora é fazer o nosso melhor — mesmo que não sejam companhias aéreas israelenses — para garantir que esses procedimentos de segurança sejam muito mais rigorosos”, disse Spielman. O órgão regulador da aviação civil dos Emirados Árabes Unidos, a GCAA, não respondeu a um pedido da Reuters para comentar sobre como seus pilotos são avaliados. Netanyahu identificou o piloto que foi atacado como o capitão Smit Machchhar, cidadão indiano. Ele disse que, apesar de ter sido “esfaqueado e gravemente ferido”, Machchhar reagiu e abriu a porta da cabine, permitindo que passageiros e tripulantes dominassem o agressor. AVALIAÇÃO DE PILOTOS FICOU MAIS RIGOROSA APÓS O 11 DE SETEMBRO Os pilotos têm passado por rigorosas verificações de segurança, especialmente desde os ataques de 11 de setembro em Nova York, há 25 anos, disseram especialistas à Reuters. “Todo piloto passa por extensas verificações de antecedentes, além de avaliações médicas e psicológicas contínuas”, disse Philip Baum, professor visitante de segurança da aviação na Universidade de Coventry, no Reino Unido. Cada país e companhia aérea é responsável por implementar os padrões de triagem e segurança estabelecidos pela Organização da Aviação Civil Internacional, mas há flexibilidade na forma como esses padrões são interpretados, disseram especialistas à Reuters. Dois pilotos que trabalham no Oriente Médio, mas não para a flydubai, disseram à Reuters que os pilotos precisam passar pelas mesmas verificações de segurança que os passageiros, o que significa que não poderiam levar armas, como facas ou revólveres, a bordo. “A responsabilidade é sempre da companhia aérea”, disse Eric Schouten, diretor da consultoria de inteligência aeronáutica Dyami. “A companhia aérea precisa realizar uma verificação adequada, de acordo com as diretrizes nacionais, sobre quem está na cabine de comando, e cada país faz isso de maneira diferente.” A Agência Europeia para a Segurança da Aviação (Easa) informou à Reuters que a certificação e a supervisão de segurança da flydubai são de competência da GCAA. “Isso inclui a responsabilidade de garantir que a operadora cumpra os requisitos aplicáveis relativos às tripulações de voo e à sua aptidão para voar”, afirmou a Easa. A Reuters não conseguiu determinar qual arma foi usada pelo piloto para esfaquear o outro. Passageiros a bordo do voo relataram que um homem segurava uma faca enquanto um dos pilotos estava ensanguentado. Um piloto que voava na região, mas não pela flydubai, disse à Reuters que os pilotos podem ter acesso a facas de metal do serviço de refeições ou a um machado de emergência disponível na maioria das cabines de comando. Spielman disse que Israel já possui algumas das verificações de segurança mais rigorosas, e que estas só tendem a se tornar ainda mais rigorosas. “Esta é uma oportunidade para todos acordarem. Israel tem as verificações de segurança mais minuciosas do mundo, e elas existem por um motivo. Elas existem para que um incidente como este não ocorra”, disse ele.

item.title: Futuros de milho fecham em queda em Chicago após surpresa no relatório de estoques do USDA
item.description: Os contratos futuros de milho na bolsa de Chicago (CBOT) caíram acentuadamente nesta quarta-feira, à medida que os investidores se apressaram a liquidar suas posições, depois que o Departamento de Agricultura dos Estados Unidos (USDA) informou que os agricultores e os comerciantes de grãos norte-americanos tinham 35% a mais de milho em estoque em 1º de setembro do que no ano anterior.
item.dc:creator: P.J. Huffstutter
item.content:encoded: Os contratos futuros de milho na bolsa de Chicago (CBOT) caíram acentuadamente nesta quarta-feira, à medida que os investidores se apressaram a liquidar suas posições, depois que o Departamento de Agricultura dos Estados Unidos (USDA) informou que os agricultores e os comerciantes de grãos norte-americanos tinham 35% a mais de milho em estoque em 1º de setembro do que no ano anterior. Os estoques de milho atingiram o maior nível em sete anos, de 2,095 bilhões de bushels em 1º de setembro, ante 1,551 bilhão no ano anterior, informou o USDA em um relatório trimestral. Analistas esperavam, em média, que a agência divulgasse 1,918 bilhão de bushels, de acordo com uma pesquisa da Reuters. O aumento maior do que o esperado derrubou os futuros de milho na CBOT , com o contrato mais negociado de dezembro caindo, em determinado momento, para uma mínima de US$4,9875 por bushel, abaixo do importante nível psicológico de US$5,00 por bushel e o menor preço do contrato desde 20 de agosto. A notícia surpreendente sobre o milho pode ser um indício de que a demanda por ração foi menor do que os operadores haviam previsto, disse Craig Turner, consultor de gestão de risco de commodities da StoneX. Ainda assim, a queda acentuada dos futuros de milho naquele dia foi igualmente surpreendente, afirmou ele. “A reação do mercado a esse relatório foi exagerada”, disse Turner. “Os fundos estavam muito otimistas em relação ao milho... Acho que algumas pessoas estão desistindo, as ordens de 'stop' estão sendo acionadas e alguns sistemas técnicos estão sendo ativados.” O contrato de milho mais negociado na CBOT fechou em queda de 21,25 centavos, a US$ 5,0075 por bushel. Os futuros de trigo da CBOT seguiram a tendência de baixa do milho, à medida que os operadores ajustavam suas posições antes do fim do mês e do trimestre. Enquanto isso, os futuros de soja da CBOT apresentaram desempenho misto, em meio a pressão contínua após a soja ter sido deixada de fora da lista de redução de tarifas divulgada após a cúpula da semana passada entre os líderes dos dois países, diminuindo as esperanças de novas compras de suprimentos dos EUA por parte das usinas privadas chinesas. Alguns analistas de mercado afirmaram que há uma preocupação crescente com a qualidade da safra de milho, tanto no armazenamento quanto nas plantações que ainda aguardam a colheita no campo. As chuvas atrasaram a colheita na região oeste do Meio-Oeste, forçando alguns processadores de soja a oferecer prêmios elevados para entregas imediatas da semente oleaginosa e outros a reduzir as operações devido à escassez de suprimentos. Os futuros de soja da CBOT fecharam em queda de 4,75 centavos, a US$12,93 por bushel, enquanto o trigo da CBOT fechou com queda de 17 centavos, a US$6,7575 por bushel. O mercado de trigo também permaneceu atento aos esforços diplomáticos para amenizar as interrupções nas exportações do Mar Negro, segundo os operadores.

item.title: Union's Cavan Sullivan youngest to win MLS player of month honor
item.description: Philadelphia Union midfielder Cavan Sullivan became the youngest MLS Player of the Month on Wednesday at 17 years and two days old.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Philadelphia Union midfielder Cavan Sullivan became the youngest MLS Player of the Month on Wednesday at 17 years and two days old. Sullivan is the youngest to earn the honor since Orlando City striker Daryl Dike (20 years, 98 days) was selected in August 2020. The Union went 5-0-0 in September with Sullivan posting an MLS-best nine goal contributions in the month. He tied for the league lead with five assists and tied for third with four goals. His streak of eight matches with a goal or assist is the longest by a teenager in MLS history. For the season, Sullivan has seven goals and 12 assists in 1,450 regular-season minutes over 24 games (17 starts). The 19 goal contributions are tied for second most by a teenager in a single MLS season, with Alphonso Davies (2018). Sullivan became the youngest player to debut in North American team sports history when he made his league debut against the New England Revolution on July 17, 2024. The Philadelphia native was 14 years and 293 days old at the time. The homegrown talent is the first in league history to progress through the MLS Player Pathway from the MLS NEXT league to MLS NEXT Pro to the first team and then earn MLS Player of the Month honors. --Field Level Media

item.description: ATLANTA -- Alec Bohm's 10th-inning home run completed the Philadelphia Phillies' comeback and kept their season alive with a 4-3 win over the host Atlanta Braves on Wednesday afternoon, forcing a winner-take-all Game 3 of their National League wild-card series on Thursday.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: ATLANTA -- Alec Bohm's 10th-inning home run completed the Philadelphia Phillies' comeback and kept their season alive with a 4-3 win over the host Atlanta Braves on Wednesday afternoon, forcing a winner-take-all Game 3 of their National League wild-card series on Thursday. After the first two batters of the frame were retired, Bohm lifted a 1-1 fastball from Didier Fuentes (0-1) just over the right field fence for his third career postseason homer. His 357-foot shot to the opposite field was his first homer in the playoffs since 2023. Phillies right-hander Andrew Painter (1-0) entered in the eighth and threw the final three innings. With the tying and winning runs on base and two outs in the 10th, he struck out pinch hitter Dominic Smith with help from an ABS challenge to record the win in his postseason debut. Bryce Harper and Bohm each had two hits and homered for the Phillies. Matt Olson had two of the three RBIs for the Braves, who left 11 runners on base and got nothing out of a bases-loaded, one-out situation with the score 1-1 in the sixth. Trailing 3-1 and down to their final six outs, Philadelphia sluggers Kyle Schwarber and Harper led off the eighth with back-to-back homers off Dylan Lee to tie the game. Harper's homer, which avenged a mistake he made misjudging a fly ball in the seventh that gave Atlanta the lead, completed the Phillies' first set of back-to-back postseason homers since Aaron Rowand and Pat Burrell did it on Oct. 3, 2007, against the Colorado Rockies. "You've got to flush (the mistake) as quick as possible knowing that Lee is coming in the game," Harper said. "And obviously I was hearing it pretty good from Braves and Phillies fans in the dugout, so got to show up in that situation. Kyle had a great at-bat, and then I wasn't not trying to hit a homer, I can tell you that. Go up there, hit the homer, 3-3." Lee allowed just three home runs in 71 regular-season appearances. "We've been winning those games all year because of our bullpen," said Braves manager Walt Weiss. "Bullpen has been, like I said all year, our most consistent strength. But some big home runs late by some really good hitters. That's what got us." The dramatic finish overshadowed what had been a stellar pitching duel. Atlanta right-hander Tyler Mahle, who suffered an abdominal pull during warmups according to Weiss, tossed seven innings of one-run ball. He allowed six hits and one walk with six strikeouts in his postseason debut. "It was right at game time after he came out of the bullpen," Weiss said of Mahle's injury. "He ended up working through it, and it got better as the game went on. But we were scrambling early on." Phillies ace Cristopher Sanchez got through six innings of one-run ball before the Braves tagged him for two more runs in the seventh on Drake Baldwin's RBI double that Harper misjudged and an Olson sacrifice fly. Sanchez went 6 2/3 innings, giving up three runs on six hits and five walks while striking out six. For the second straight day, the Phillies opened the scoring in the first inning as Harper's single scored Trea Turner after his leadoff double. Mahle got a pair of clutch outs to strand runners on the corners. The Braves immediately erased that lead when Olson blooped a two-out single to right to score Ronald Acuna Jr., who led off with a walk then stole second and third. --Curt Weiler, Field Level Media

item.title: Ukraine urges US to sanction entities supporting Russia's Starlink rival
item.description: Ukraine is urging the United States to impose sanctions on several Russian entities that it says are helping develop Moscow's Rassvet satellite network as a domestic alternative to SpaceX's Starlink, its acting ambassador said on Wednesday.
item.dc:creator: Andrea Shalal
item.content:encoded: Ukraine is urging the United States to impose sanctions on several Russian entities that it says are helping develop Moscow's Rassvet satellite network as a domestic alternative to SpaceX's Starlink, its acting ambassador said on Wednesday. Denys Sienik, deputy chief of mission at the Ukrainian embassy in Washington, told reporters that Russia was rapidly expanding the Rassvet satellite network, saying its goal to start operations in 2027 would pose grave risks to Ukraine. "If they launch Rassvet by the end of 2026, they will be able to target to hit Ukrainian targets real time on our territory," Sienik said, adding that he would share details with the US government and Congress about the firms and individuals that Kyiv accuses of aiding Rassvet. Ukraine plans to issue its own national sanctions against the entities linked to the network, Sienik said, adding: "If these entities are not sanctioned, it will actually make this program possible for Russia and that will be a game-changer." Russia plans to start operating Rassvet, a smaller version of Elon Musk's Starlink system, in 2027, [USN:L6N42D0R7 TEXT:"Alexei Shelobkov,"] CEO of Iks Holding, the company developing the service, said in June. The company launched its first 16 low-orbit satellites in March and plans to reach 900 over several years. SpaceX currently has over 10,000 satellites in orbit. Starlink is banned in Russia, and the use of its equipment is subject to fines. Western nations have targeted the infrastructure behind Russia's space-based communications efforts, but gaps remain. Kyiv has been pressing Washington to expand sanctions against a broader group of Russian companies and individuals. Ukraine has been clamoring for access to expanded Starlink satellite internet coverage so it can strike Russian ballistic missile launchers located inside Russian territory, a message backed [USN:S8N3P40ER TEXT:"by Finnish President Alexander Stubb"] last week. With winter looming, Ukraine has an acute shortage of air defenses to repel Russian ballistic missiles, and Kyiv officials believe that turning on Starlink over Russian territory would help it target the Russian launchers that fire the missiles. Sienik also expressed frustration about the lack of US response when American firms were hit in Ukraine, noting that US officials had complained loudly when Ukraine had targeted US assets in the Caspian Sea, resulting in closer cooperation and more precise targeting. But Washington remained silent in terms of messaging to Moscow when US firms in Ukraine were struck, and officials were even reluctant to name the companies affected, he said. Sienik last week posted details of US firms being hit by Russia missiles in Ukraine, including offices of Boeing, Flex and Bunge. A Coca-Cola facility in the Kyiv region was also hit in September, along with a logistics facility serving McDonald’s, he said in his message on X. "It is not a coincidence, Russia knows what it is doing by attacking regular businesses operating in Ukraine, supported by American investment and serving civilian needs," he wrote. "While Russia must be deprived of the possibility to cause more deaths and destruction by strong sanctions, Ukraine must have enough air defense capabilities to protect itself but also to ensure the security of the American businesses operating and investing in Ukraine."

item.title: Ofcom survey did not rank GB News as UK’s most trusted news channel
item.description: A survey revealed GB News as the UK news channel with the highest proportion of its viewers saying it was trustworthy, contrary to online posts that claimed the poll ranked it as the most trusted among all British news channels.
item.dc:creator: Reuters Fact Check
item.content:encoded: A survey revealed GB News as the UK news channel with the highest proportion of its viewers saying it was trustworthy, contrary to online posts that claimed the poll ranked it as the most trusted among all British news channels. The poll results, released by Ofcom, were part of the UK media regulator’s 2026 report on news consumption in the UK. “OFFICIAL: GB News is now the UK’s most trusted news channel according to Ofcom’s own survey,” a September 23 post on Facebook said. However, a spokesperson for Ofcom said in an email its survey results are only about whether those who watch GB News trust it, not the general population. Ofcom has not carried out any research designed to test which news providers are the most trusted in the UK, the spokesperson added. The survey, the results of which are available to download , asked people who had viewed GB News in the last month whether the news they saw, read or heard on the channel was trustworthy. Asked to rank trustworthiness on a scale of 1-10, with 10 being the most trustworthy, 74% of respondents gave a ranking between 7 and 10. For BBC television, 66% of viewers were positive about trustworthiness. For ITV 1, it was 67% and Sky News, 71%. A survey for the Reuters Institute for the Study of Journalism, published in 2026, said BBC News got the highest trust rating, with 57% of respondents giving the broadcaster a trust ranking of between six and 10. The equivalent score for GB News was 27%. The survey said the ranking was not exhaustive and therefore could not conclude the BBC was the most trusted provider. GB News, which did not respond to a request for comment, said in a September 23 online article that the Ofcom survey had revealed that “GB News is more trusted by its viewers than either the BBC or Sky News”. VERDICT Misleading. The survey revealed GB News as the UK news channel with the highest proportion of its viewers saying it was trustworthy, not that it was the most trusted among all British news channels. This article was produced by the Reuters Fact Check team. Read more about our fact-checking work.

item.title: What is red-dyed diesel and can it help lower prices, as Trump wants?
item.description: The White House is considering regulatory relief that would expand sales of red-dyed diesel, a tax-exempt fuel typically used for farming, as prices surge following supply disruptions linked to the US conflict with Iran, Ukrainian strikes on Russian refineries and declining global inventories.
item.dc:creator: Nicole Jao
item.content:encoded: The White House is considering regulatory relief that would expand sales of red-dyed diesel, a tax-exempt fuel typically used for farming, as prices surge following supply disruptions linked to the US conflict with Iran, Ukrainian strikes on Russian refineries and declining global inventories. Analysts warn such relief would do little to combat the problem of shrinking supply that has driven prices to record levels. Here is more about the problems plaguing the diesel market, and what effect, if any, broader use of red-dye diesel may have: WHAT IS THE WHITE HOUSE PROPOSING TO DO? Diesel prices in the US reached a record $6.53 per gallon last week, according to Energy Information Administration data, due to a combination of a reduction in supply from the Middle East and interruptions to refining, in part because of Ukraine's attacks on Russian energy facilities. The spike has prompted the White House to consider allowing broader sales of red-dyed diesel, as President Donald Trump and his administration face pressure to ease fuel costs ahead of November's midterm elections. It has also weighed a [USN:L6N45G0YB TEXT:"blanket diesel export ban,"] by refiners, and has [USN:L1N45L0RG TEXT:"urged the European Union"] to release emergency diesel stocks to help ease prices. WHAT IS RED-DYED DIESEL? Red-dyed diesel is essentially diesel but exempt from highway fuel taxes. It is generally sold for use in equipment and vehicles that are not usually operated on public roadways, but for places like farms and construction sites. Because it is intended for off-road use, it is exempt from taxes applied to diesel fuel sold for highway transportation. The fuel is almost chemically identical to on-road diesel. The red dye serves as a tax-enforcement marker, indicating that highway taxes have not been paid. Using dyed diesel in vehicles operated on public roads is illegal and can result in significant fines because it constitutes tax evasion, not because the fuel differs from standard diesel. Several states [USN:L6N45L18J TEXT:"have relaxed"] restrictions on dyed diesel amid surging fuel costs. HOW MUCH TAX DO DRIVERS PAY ON A GALLON OF DIESEL FUEL? Highway diesel fuel in the United States is subject to both federal and state excise taxes. Federal levies include a diesel tax of 24.3 cents per gallon and a 0.1-cent-per-gallon underground storage tank fee, together accounting for roughly 4% of a $6-a-gallon diesel. State diesel taxes average about 35.5 cents per gallon, representing roughly 5% of current diesel prices. HOW MUCH DIESEL DOES THE US CONSUME? Off-road diesel accounts for about 30% of total US distillate consumption at roughly 18.2 billion gallons annually, according to Jim Mitchell, an analyst at consultancy Wood Mackenzie. The U.S. transportation sector consumes nearly 123 million gallons of diesel daily, or about 45 billion gallons annually, according to federal data. That represents roughly 75% of total US distillate consumption of nearly 60 billion gallons per year. WHAT DO ANALYSTS THINK THESE MEASURES WOULD DO? "One doesn't have to pay federal and state excise taxes on dyed diesel, but it really doesn't shift the amount of overall diesel manufactured for domestic purposes," said Tom Kloza, chief energy adviser at Gulf Oil. "It would help less than it sounds like, and the version the administration can do without Congress wouldn't lower pump prices at all," said Gregg Ibendahl, an agricultural economics professor at Kansas State University. "It's a much safer idea than the export ban — mostly because it does less." "While expanding access to the tax-exempt diesel could provide some relief to eligible end-users, it would not change the underlying wholesale diesel price," said Preben Sørli, analyst at Rystad Energy. "Refiners would still receive market price for their fuels, and the main effect would be lowering federal tax revenues. It would do little to change supply or market fundamentals."

item.title: Constellation, Amazon sign 20-year power deal to support Maryland nuclear plant
item.description: Constellation Energy and Amazon.com on Wednesday announced a 20-year power purchase agreement that will support the expansion of the Calvert Cliffs nuclear plant in Maryland.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Constellation Energy (CEG.O) and Amazon.com (AMZN.O) on Wednesday announced a 20-year power purchase agreement that will support the expansion of the Calvert Cliffs nuclear plant in Maryland. Demand for nuclear energy is increasing as technology companies seek dependable sources of power for AI-driven computing infrastructure. Here are some more details: The agreement will enable more than $3 billion in Maryland infrastructure investment, including about 190 megawatts of new emissions-free generating capacity coming online between 2030 and 2032. The deal includes 690 MW of power from Constellation's 1,790 MW Calvert Cliffs nuclear plant. The companies also entered into a retail supply agreement to support Amazon's operations in the 13-state PJM power market, they said in a statement. Amazon's long-term commitment is expected to support Constellation's efforts to renew Calvert Cliffs' operating license for another 20 years. The agreement could also support the development of advanced nuclear and other clean-energy projects at the site. Calvert Cliffs is Maryland's only nuclear power plant and produces about 80% of the state's clean energy, generating enough electricity to power the equivalent of more than 1.3 million homes, according to the statement.

item.title: South Korea unveils major energy investment plans in US
item.description: South Korea officially unveiled comprehensive implementation plans on Thursday for three major energy initiatives in the US, advancing a $350 billion strategic investment package designed to secure critical exemptions from punishing US import tariffs.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: South Korea officially unveiled comprehensive implementation plans on Thursday for three major energy initiatives in the US , advancing a $350 billion strategic investment package designed to secure critical exemptions from punishing US import tariffs . The two will launch a $22.3 billion gas-fired power project in Encinal, Texas , to directly power artificial intelligence data centers, with initial commercial operations slated for 2029, according to the South Korean government. US President Donald Trump also announced the plan in a briefing at the White House on Wednesday. Here are details of the projects, according to the Korean government: The 6.47-gigawatt-hour plant is scheduled to begin commercial operations in 2029, the Korean government said in a statement issued in Seoul on Thursday following Trump's announcement. South Korea plans to invest $120 billion in building eight nuclear reactors in the US, including two based on South Korea's APR-1400 design. Seoul and Washington will review a project to build pipelines and a terminal to transport and export liquefied natural gas in Alaska , although the project will proceed only if commercial and legal conditions are met. South Korea's investments will be capped at $20 billion annually under a legally binding agreement. Profit will be equally split between South Korea and the US until South Korea recovers its principal investment across all projects. Specific details on the nuclear power plant project haven't been decided yet.

item.title: Steelers rule out Joey Porter Jr.; Jalen Ramsey hopes to play vs. Browns
item.description: Steelers cornerback Joey Porter Jr. will miss his fourth straight game when Pittsburgh visits the Cleveland Browns on Thursday night.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Steelers cornerback Joey Porter Jr. will miss his fourth straight game when Pittsburgh visits the Cleveland Browns on Thursday night. Porter was limited in practice Wednesday after coach Mike McCarthy expressed hope earlier this week that he would make his season debut. Porter, 26, has been slowly recovering from a back injury and his conditioning has been improving. Fellow Pittsburgh cornerback Jalen Ramsey (wrist) is listed as questionable but hopes to play. He says he broke his right wrist early in Sunday's 30-27 victory over the Cincinnati Bengals. "I'm going to try to (play), but I've got to be able to protect it," Ramsey, an eight-time Pro Bowl selection, told reporters. "Obviously, it's a real injury. A broken wrist. I can't do anything about it." Running back Rico Dowdle (toe) will miss his second consecutive game and cornerback Brandin Echols (concussion) is questionable. Jaylen Warren will again be the primary running back for the Steelers. He had 176 scrimmage yards (127 rushing, 49 receiving) against Cincinnati. "What a tough guy," quarterback Aaron Rodgers said of Warren. "I've always had respect for him, played against him and then being his teammate now for a little more than a season. He is one of the toughest guys I've ever played with." For Cleveland, receiver Tylan Wallace (knee), center Elgton Jenkins (concussion) and guard Teven Jenkins (back) were ruled out. Teven Jenkins will miss his fourth straight game. --Field Level Media

item.title: Preços do açúcar bruto caem com vencimento do contrato de outubro na ICE
item.description: Os futuros do açúcar bruto na ICE caíram nesta quarta-feira, com o vencimento do contrato de outubro servindo de foco no curto prazo, enquanto os preços do café arábica registraram uma leve alta.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Os futuros do açúcar bruto na ICE caíram nesta quarta-feira, com o vencimento do contrato de outubro servindo de foco no curto prazo, enquanto os preços do café arábica registraram uma leve alta. AÇÚCAR * O contrato de açúcar bruto fechou em queda de 0,19 centavo, ou 1,1%, a 17,63 centavos por libra-peso. * Operadores afirmaram que a oferta permaneceu abundante, com o contrato de outubro fechando com um desconto de 1,02 centavos em relação ao de março em seu último dia de negociação. * O vencimento registrou entregas de 1,45 milhão de toneladas métricas, tendo a brasileira BTG Pactual Commodities como principal fornecedora e a asiática Wilmar como única receptora do açúcar, segundo os corretores. * As entregas ficaram em linha com as expectativas do mercado de um volume ligeiramente abaixo das 1,52 milhão de toneladas entregues no contrato de outubro de 2025. * O açúcar branco recuou 0,6%, para US$ 506,30 por tonelada. * Não houve participantes em uma licitação do Paquistão para vender e exportar 107.739 toneladas de açúcar branco, segundo os corretores . * A Índia registrou sua menor precipitação de monção em mais de uma década durante a temporada de junho a setembro, já que o fenômeno climático El Niño reduziu a precipitação. CAFÉ * O café arábica fechou em alta de 1,25 centavos, ou 0,4%, a US$2,907 por libra. * Os corretores afirmaram que o mercado foi impulsionado, em parte, por possíveis problemas de qualidade na safra brasileira de 2026, devido à maior umidade associada ao atual El Niño. * A Cooxupé, maior cooperativa cafeeira do Brasil e principal exportadora brasileira de café, informou em um comunicado aos seus produtores associados na terça-feira que rejeitará grãos com problemas de qualidade causados pelo excesso de umidade. * Os corretores afirmaram que a alta nos preços também foi impulsionada, em parte, por questões técnicas, com o mercado apresentando sobrevenda após uma queda acentuada em relação aos picos recentes registrados no final de agosto. * O café robusta subiu 1%, para US$ 3.445 a tonelada. (Reportagem de Nigel Hunt e Marcelo Teixeira)

item.title: Brazil's Nubank says it is not pursuing deal with Monzo
